paper.title_en: Wobbling Motion in the Many-Nucleon System
paper.abstract_en: The purpose of this Perspective is not to present a new progress but to shed light on another stream of the study of the nuclear wobbling motion from a viewpoint of the many-body theory under an external field. Special attention is paid to the moments of inertia, which are microscopically calculated as a response of the full $A$-body system to rapid rotations described by the cranked RPA formalism. They depend on the rotation frequency, and it is shown that approach of two moments of inertia leads to the instability of rotating triaxial mean fields.
publication_info: 14, Matsuzaki M (2026) Wobbling motion in the many-nucleon system. Front. Phys. 14:1965157, 1965157, publication, Front.Phys.
